decision.explanation: The question asks for the spouse of Robert Bruce, Lord Kennet. The documents present two distinct referents: one historical (D2S3-D2S20) and one contemporary (D1S1-D1S19). D2S9 explicitly states that the historical Robert Bruce, Lord Kennet (died 1748), married Helen Abercromby. D1S1-D1S19 describe a modern Robert Bruce, Lord Kennet (age 75), who married Emma Wood. These are separate individuals with the same name. Both answers are valid and distinct.
